name: European Ink and Watercolor Vignette
name_es: Viñeta europea en tinta y acuarela
swap_rule: Se cita el id. Se puede aplicar el estilo gráfico a distintos sujetos o escenas sin alterar su contenido base. Se mantienen el lenguaje visual, la línea entintada y el tratamiento en acuarela.

style.color_mode: soft muted color palette with watercolor washes
style.line_quality: clean hand-inked contour lines with expressive variations in thickness
style.rendering: transparent watercolor layers, soft bleeding edges, light pigment pooling, and sketch-like tonal transitions
style.detail_level: moderate detail, stylized rather than photorealistic
style.facial_treatment: illustrated face with simplified but elegant features, expressive eyes, and controlled linework rather than realistic rendering
style.figure_treatment: elongated stylish proportions with graceful posture and fashion-illustration sensibility
style.background: suggested urban environment with loose architectural indication, atmospheric washes, and minimal hard detail
style.texture: visible paper feel and watercolor granulation suggested
style.composition_behavior: single-scene narrative illustration, similar to a European comic or fashion editorial panel
style.overall_look: elegant European-style illustration combining ink drawing and watercolor, atmospheric, refined, and slightly nostalgic

notes: Este archivo describe únicamente el estilo gráfico de la imagen. La pose, vestuario y escena específica pueden citarse por separado en módulos independientes si corresponde.
